```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, eval = F)
```

```{r load_packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

```

In the GWAS Catalog, broad ancestry grouping in some cases is listed as 'NR' or includes multiple ancestry groups even though the descriptions provided would allow us to infer a more specific ancestry group. This script pre-processes the GWAS Catalog ancestry dataset to harmonize the broad ancestry grouping and extract population descriptors from the sample descriptions.

# Filter ancestry description dataset to relevant study accessions 

## Get relevant study accessions

From GWAS study info that has been mapped to GBD causes / diseases, get the study accessions of studies that are relevant to our selected diseases.

```{r get_study_accessions}

# get only relevant disease studies
gwas_study_info <- data.table::fread(here::here("output/icd_map/gwas_study_accession_gbd_causes.csv"))

gwas_study_info = gwas_study_info |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x))

gwas_study_info = gwas_study_info |>
  dplyr::filter(cause != "") |>
  dplyr::filter(include == T)

gwas_study_info  <-
  gwas_study_info  |>
  # group into broader categories 
  mutate(cause_grp = case_when(
    grepl("diabetes", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Diabetes",
    grepl("chronic kidney disease", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Chronic kidney disease",
    grepl("hemorr", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Hemorrhagic stroke",
    grepl("lip|pharynx", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mouth and throat cancer",
    grepl("lung cancer", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Lung Cancer",
    grepl("cirrhosis", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Chronic Liver Disease",
    TRUE ~ cause
  )) 

selected_study_accessions <- gwas_study_info |> pull(STUDY_ACCESSION) |> 
  unique()

length(selected_study_accessions)

```

## Get relevant ancestry descriptions

```{r load_gwas_ancest}

gwas_ancest_info <-  data.table::fread(here::here("data/gwas_catalog/gwas-catalog-v1.0.3.1-ancestries-r2026-09-13.tsv"),
                                       sep = "\t",
                                       quote = "")

gwas_ancest_info = gwas_ancest_info |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x))

gwas_ancest_subset <-
  gwas_ancest_info |>
  filter(STUDY_ACCESSION %in% selected_study_accessions)

```

## Freeze ancestry description columns

That may be modified in the pre-processing steps below, so we can compare to original values later.

```{r freeze_ancestry_columns}

gwas_ancest_subset <-
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
  mutate(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY_ORIG = BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY) |>
  mutate(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_ORIG = NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS) |>
  mutate(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION_ORIG = INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION) 

```


# Pre-processing GWAS Catalog ancestry dataset

## Harmonizing BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY 

### Order ancestry groups alphabetically

```{r reorder_BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY}

# reorder BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY alphabetically
gwas_ancest_subset  <-
  gwas_ancest_subset  |>
  mutate(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY = purrr::map_chr(
    str_split(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY,
              stringr::regex("(?<!Eastern), ")),
    ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ", ")))

# don't split after eastern, as this tends to be 'Middle Eastern, North African or Persian'
# gwas_ancest_subset |>
    # filter(str_detect(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY_ORIG,
    #                   "(?<=Eastern), "))  |> pull(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY_ORIG) |> unique()

# check that this hasn't broken ancestry groups with commas in descriptions
gwas_ancest_subset |>
  filter(str_detect(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY_ORIG,
                    "(?<!Eastern), ")) |>
  pull(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY) |>
  unique() 

```

## Apply manual edits

Study-specific corrections are listed, with reasons, in
`data/gwas_catalog/gwas_cat_ancestry_hardcoded_edits.xlsx`. They are applied in row order,
so each `condition` sees the result of the edits above it.

```{r}

edits_xlsx <-  here::here("data/gwas_catalog/gwas_cat_ancestry_hardcoded_edits.xlsx")
  
key_cols   <- c("STUDY_ACCESSION", "STAGE",
                "BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY_ORIG", "NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_ORIG")

read_edits <- function(sheet, value_col = NULL) {
  readxl::read_excel(edits_xlsx, sheet = sheet) |>
    select(all_of(c(key_cols, value_col)))   # drop the grey information columns
}

gwas_ancest_subset <- tibble::as_tibble(gwas_ancest_subset)

# split rows that combine several ancestry groups but get per-group values below
split_studies <- readxl::read_excel(edits_xlsx, sheet = "split_rows")$STUDY_ACCESSION

gwas_ancest_subset <- bind_rows(
  gwas_ancest_subset |> filter(!STUDY_ACCESSION %in% split_studies),
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
    filter(STUDY_ACCESSION %in% split_studies) |>
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY_ORIG,
                                 delim = regex("(?<!Eastern), ")) |>
    mutate(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY = BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY_ORIG)
)

# the key must identify each row exactly once
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(select(gwas_ancest_subset, all_of(key_cols))) == 0)

gwas_ancest_subset <-
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
  rows_delete(read_edits("delete_rows"), by = key_cols) |>
  rows_insert(readxl::read_excel(edits_xlsx, sheet = "insert_rows") |> select(-edit_id, -reason), by = key_cols) |>
  rows_update(read_edits("update_ancestry",    "BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY"),   by = key_cols) |>
  rows_update(read_edits("update_description", "INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION"), by = key_cols) |>
  rows_update(read_edits("update_n",           "NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS"),      by = key_cols)

```

## Cleaning up  INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION

```{r}

# remove "(MTAG boosted by ...)" from sample descriptions, as it is not relevant to ancestry
gwas_ancest_subset <-
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
  mutate(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION = str_remove_all(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
                                                     pattern = "\\(MTAG boosted by [\\d,]+ [^)]+\\)"))

# remove 'up to' from sample descriptions, as it is not relevant to ancestry
gwas_ancest_subset <-
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
  mutate(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION = str_remove_all(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
                                                     pattern = "(?<=^|, )[Uu]p to ")) |>
  mutate(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION = str_remove_all(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
                                                     pattern = "(?<=^|, )upto ")) |>
    mutate(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION = str_remove_all(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
                                                     pattern = "(?<=,)up to")) 

# remove at least
gwas_ancest_subset <-
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
  mutate(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION = str_remove_all(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
                                                     pattern = "(?<=^|, )[Aa]t least "))

# remove ~ or approximately 
gwas_ancest_subset <-
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
  mutate(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION = str_remove_all(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
                                                     pattern = "~|approximately"))


```

# Deal with multiple ancestry groups in BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY

## Extract population descriptors from INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION

```{r extract_population_desc_INITIAL}

initial_sample_desc_multiple <-
gwas_ancest_subset |>
  filter(STAGE == "initial") |>
  filter(grepl("(?<!Eastern), ", BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY, perl = T)) |>
  select(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
         BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY,
         NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS,
         STUDY_ACCESSION,
         PUBMED_ID)  |>
  mutate(GWAS_SAMPLE_DESC = INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION) # |>
  # tidyr::separate_longer_delim(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY,
  #                              delim = regex("(?<!Eastern), ")) 
# add column to help with grouping later

# split each description into its components at ", " followed by a number
# (splitting on the number itself would delete it, as separate_longer_delim
# drops the delimiter)
sample_split_pattern <- ",\\s+(?=\\d+)"

initial_sample_desc_multiple <-
  initial_sample_desc_multiple |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
                               delim = stringr::regex(sample_split_pattern)) |>
  mutate(
      n = INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION |>
      str_extract("^\\d[\\d,]*(?=\\s)") |>  # leading number (may contain thousands commas)
      str_remove_all(",") |>
      as.integer(),
    sample_description = INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION |>
      str_remove("^(up to\\s+)?\\d[\\d,]*\\s+")  # drop "up to" + the number
  ) 

# check where there is not comma in INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION
# n should equal n
# initial_sample_desc |>
#   filter(!str_detect(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
#                     ",\\s+(?=\\d)")) |>
#   filter(!str_detect(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY,
#                     ",")) |>
#   #filter(!grepl(",[0", INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION)) |>
#   filter(grepl("^[0-9]+", INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION)) |>
#   filter(!grepl("trios|pairs", sample_description)) |>
#   group_by(STUDY_ACCESSION, NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS) |>
#   summarise(n = sum(n)) |>
#   filter(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS != n) |>
#   nrow()
# 
# initial_sample_desc <-
#   initial_sample_desc |>
#   mutate(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_ORIG = NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS) |>
#   mutate(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS = ifelse(!str_detect(INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION,
#                     ",\\s+(?=\\d)") &
#                                          grepl("^[0-9]+", INITIAL_SAMPLE_DESCRIPTION) &
#                                          !grepl("trios|pairs", sample_description) & 
#                                           NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS != n,
#                                         n,
#                                         NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_ORIG)
#   )
#   

# check no missed samples
initial_sample_desc_multiple |>
  filter(str_detect(sample_description,
                    "(?<![Tt]ype )(?<!COVID-)(?<!\\< )(?<!\\> )\\b[0-9]+(?!\\%)(?!\\-)")) |>
  nrow()

initial_sample_desc_multiple |>
  filter(str_detect(sample_description,
                    "(?<![Tt]ype )(?<!COVID-)(?<!\\< )(?<!\\>)\\b[0-9]+\\b(?!\\%)")) |>
  pull(sample_description) |>
  unique()

```

### Account for sibling pairs / trios in numbers

The leading number in a sample description usually counts individuals, including
"N individuals from M families". Only when the description *ends* with a group
unit (e.g. "69 European ancestry trios") does it count groups.
NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS is left unchanged; only `n` is converted.

```{r account_for_family_units, eval = F}

initial_sample_desc <-
  initial_sample_desc |>
  mutate(
    n_text = n,  # number as written in the description
    multiplier = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_description, "\\btrios$")          ~ 3,
      str_detect(sample_description, "\\b(duos|pairs)$")   ~ 2,
      TRUE                                                ~ 1
    ),
    n = n_text * multiplier
  )

# Units with no fixed size: use the total reported in the paper.
# GCST005536 (PMID 25751624): 10,796 individuals in 2,601 ASP families + 69 trios,
# so ASP families = 10,796 - 3 * 69 = 10,589 individuals
initial_sample_desc <-
  initial_sample_desc |>
  mutate(
    n_overridden = STUDY_ACCESSION == "GCST005536" &
                   str_detect(sample_description, "affected sibling pair families$"),
    n = if_else(n_overridden, 10589, n)
  )

# Stop if a new catalog release adds a group unit that isn't handled above
unhandled_units <-
  initial_sample_desc |>
  filter(str_detect(sample_description,
                    "\\b(families|sibships|pedigrees|twins|quads)$"),
         !str_detect(sample_description, "\\bfrom\\b"),  # "N people from M families" is fine
         !n_overridden)

unhandled_units |> select(STUDY_ACCESSION, sample_description, n_text)
stopifnot(nrow(unhandled_units) == 0)
```

## Get broad ancestry group of each sample description

```{r get_broad_ancestry_INITIAL}

source(here::here("code/pop_desc_processing/gwas_cat_metadata.R"))

initial_ancestry_sample_desc <-
  initial_sample_desc_multiple  |>
  # extract population descriptors
  mutate(sample_ancestry = get_ancestry_from_sample_desc(sample_description)) |>
  distinct()

# initial_ancestry_sample_desc <-
# initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
#    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(sample_ancestry, "; ") |>
#     mutate(sample_broad_ancestry = group_pop_labels(sample_ancestry)
#   ) 

initial_ancestry_sample_desc <-
initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
# group population descriptors
rowwise() |>
mutate(sample_broad_ancestry =
           paste0(sort(
                        unique(group_pop_labels(
                          
                          unlist(str_split(string = sample_ancestry, "; "))
                                                )
                               )
                        ),
                  collapse = ", ")
  ) |>
  ungroup()

#                                ))

#

#                                                 )
#                                )
#                         ),
#                   collapse = ", ")
#   ) |>
#   ungroup()

initial_ancestry_sample_desc <-
  initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
  distinct()

initial_ancestry_sample_desc  <-
initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
  group_by(PUBMED_ID,
         STUDY_ACCESSION,
         GWAS_SAMPLE_DESC
) |>
  summarise(sample_broad_ancestry = 
              paste0(sort(
                        unique(group_pop_labels(
                          
                          unlist(str_split(string = sample_ancestry, "; "))
                                                )
                               )
                        ),
                  collapse = ", "),
BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY =
  paste0(sort(unique(unlist(
    str_split(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY, regex("(?<!Eastern), "))
  ))), collapse = ", "),
N = sum(n)
)

unmatched_pmids <-
initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
  group_by(PUBMED_ID,
         STUDY_ACCESSION,
         GWAS_SAMPLE_DESC
         #NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS
) |>
  summarise(sample_broad_ancestry = 
              paste0(sort(
                        unique(group_pop_labels(
                          
                          unlist(str_split(string = sample_ancestry, "; "))
                                                )
                               )
                        ),
                  collapse = ", "),
BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY =
  paste0(sort(unique(unlist(
    str_split(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY, regex("(?<!Eastern), "))
  ))), collapse = ", ")
) |>
  filter(!any(sample_broad_ancestry %in% BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY)) |>
  pull(PUBMED_ID) |>
  unique()
```

## Compare estimated total number of samples

```{r compare_total_n_INITIAL}

initial_ancestry_sample_desc <-
  initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
  filter(sample_broad_ancestry == BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY)

# NA's introduced for GCST90449028
# fine - number of individuals is NA for this STUDY_ACCESSION
  initial_summed_sample_desc <-
  initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(n = as.integer(n)) |>
  # select(PUBMED_ID,

  # distinct() |>

           NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS,
           GWAS_SAMPLE_DESC,
           BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY) |>
  summarise(n_sample_desc = sum(n)) 

  
  initial_summed_sample_desc |>
  filter(!between(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS,
                 n_sample_desc,
                 n_sample_desc + 10)) |>
  nrow()

  initial_summed_sample_desc |>
  filter(n_sample_desc != NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS) |>
  nrow()

    pull(PUBMED_ID) |>
```

## Initial ancestry sample description components

```{r}

discovery_sample_ancestry_desc <-
rbind(
  gwas_ancest_subset |>
    filter(STAGE == "initial") |>
    filter(!grepl("(?<!Eastern), ", BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY, perl = T)) |>
    distinct(PUBMED_ID,
           STUDY_ACCESSION,
           BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY,
           NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS),
   initial_ancestry_sample_desc |>
    select(BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY = sample_broad_ancestry,
           STUDY_ACCESSION,
           PUBMED_ID,
           NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS = N)
  )

out_dir <- here::here("output/gwas_cat")

# cleaned GWAS Catalog ancestry table (all stages),
# with corrected BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY and sample descriptions
data.table::fwrite(discovery_sample_ancestry_desc,
                   file.path(out_dir, "gwas_ancest_discovery_subset_processed.csv"))


```




# Save processed tables

```{r save_processed_tables}

out_dir <- here::here("output/gwas_cat")

# cleaned GWAS Catalog ancestry table (all stages),
# with corrected BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY and sample descriptions
data.table::fwrite(gwas_ancest_subset,
                   file.path(out_dir, "gwas_ancest_subset_processed.csv"))

# initial-stage sample description components, one row per
# (study, ancestry group, sample description component),
# with extracted sample size (n) and inferred broad ancestry;
# restricted to components whose inferred ancestry matches BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY
data.table::fwrite(initial_ancestry_sample_desc,
                   file.path(out_dir, "gwas_ancest_initial_sample_desc_processed.csv"))

```
